items.title: Capability agent-claude-cli needs setup
items.detail: Setup: Install the Claude CLI so DontPanic can spawn agent runs through the governed executor.; Authenticate the Claude CLI against the operator's Claude account or API key. (needs you)
items.plain_consequence: Prints the setup steps for agent-claude-cli so you can complete it.

items.title: Capability discord-notify needs setup
items.detail: Setup: Configure the Discord webhook URL the sink will POST NotifyEvent messages to (env var or ~/.dontpanic/discord.json). (needs you); Send a test NotifyEvent to the configured Discord webhook to confirm end-to-end delivery.
items.plain_consequence: Prints the setup steps for discord-notify so you can complete it.

items.title: Capability linear is not installed
items.detail: Setup: Generate the Printing Press Linear adapter binary the operator will register with DontPanic.; Register the emitted Linear adapter binary with DontPanic so plan close/resync can find it.; Paste the operator's Linear API token into ~/.dontpanic/adapters/linear.json so the adapter can authenticate. (needs you); Validate the PM-tool category mapping (status, priority, project) resolves against the operator's Linear workspace.
items.plain_consequence: Prints the setup steps for linear so you can complete it.

items.title: Raise the cap to allow one more iteration
items.detail: Alternative: if a defect is fixable in one more pass, raise loop_caps.max_iterations in the plan, then redispatch. There is no single gate to resume here — `dontpanic resume` requires a specific `--gate <name>` or `--all`, and neither applies to an exhausted cap — so no command is emitted. Confirm the extra spend is worth it. Human action required. (see dashboard affordance)
items.plain_consequence: Alternative: if a defect is fixable in one more pass, raise loop_caps.max_iterations in the plan, then redispatch. items.title: Close the feature — iterations exhausted
items.detail: max_iterations exhausted: 2/2 fix iterations used; the next fix iteration is OVER cap. Redispatch would exceed the cap. If the work is acceptable, operator-resolve the close-out with `dontpanic close --operator-resolved 2026-05-01-001-feat-android-sprint1-parity-fixes F001 --reason <class>`, choosing the <class> yourself. Human action required. (see dashboard affordance)

items.title: Close the feature as operator-resolved
items.detail: Alternative: if the remaining work is acceptable or out of scope, close it out with `dontpanic close --operator-resolved 2026-05-01-001-feat-android-sprint1-parity-fixes F001 --reason <class>`, choosing the <class> yourself. Confirm the classification. Human action required. (see dashboard affordance)

items.title: Resume past breaker:no_progress after a fix
items.detail: breaker:no_progress tripped: repeated rounds produced no new progress signal.. If you have a fix that breaks the stall, resume past this specific gate. Risk: re-tripping if nothing changed. (see dashboard affordance)
